steps_remove-bg_1Desc: Select a photo or graphic with a background you want to remove. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, and WebP. The image stays on your device — no server upload.
steps_remove-bg_2Desc: Click Remove Background — the AI model runs entirely in your browser. The first time may take a few seconds while the model loads and caches; subsequent runs are faster.
steps_remove-bg_3Desc: Download the transparent PNG for use in design tools, presentations, e-commerce listings, or social media.
